$$\exists N \in \mathbb{N}:\ 4 \le N$$

The one hypothesis of the statement, $4 \le N$, holds at $N = 4$.

$$\exists M \in \mathbb{N}:\ \mathrm{True}$$

The statement quantifies over $M$ with no hypothesis, so its witness is any natural number; $M = 0$ is used. It says nothing about the fractional parts.
